title: How H&M’s Recycling Machines Make New Clothes From Used Apparel | World Wide Waste
summary: A Business Insider World Wide Waste episode on H&M's garment recycling machines, which turn used clothing into new apparel. It asks whether a fast fashion company can solve the waste problem it helped create.
why: Cited in threads on textile waste and clothing supply chains as an example of an industrial recycling attempt, with some skepticism about how far it progressed.

quote.text: I was fascinated by attempts to "process" old fabrics and mix them with other fabrics to create new garments
